directories.description: List of directory paths to scan for duplicates.

action.description: The primary action to take on duplicate files. Valid: print, delete, hard-link, soft-link, dedupe, link-hard, link-soft.

auto_delete.description: If true, automatically delete duplicates without prompting (implies -N). Requires action=delete.

exclude_hidden.description: Exclude hidden files (starting with .) from consideration.

one_file_system.description: Do not match files that are on different filesystems.

ignore_hard_links.description: Normally hard links are treated as non-duplicates; this option changes that behavior.

recurse.description: Recurse into subdirectories of the given directories.

sort_order.description: Sort order for matches. Valid: name, time.

exclude_extensions.description: List of file extensions to exclude (e.g., 'txt'). Comma-separated in output, no leading dot.

include_extensions.description: List of file extensions to include only (e.g., 'jpg'). Comma-separated in output, no leading dot.

exclude_substrings.description: List of substrings to exclude from file paths (e.g., 'cache/').

include_substrings.description: List of substrings that must be present in file paths (e.g., 'photos/').

hash_db.description: Path to a hash database file for caching results. Use '.' for default 'jdupes_hashdb.txt'.

chunk_size.description: I/O chunk size in KiB. 0 uses default.

print_info.description: Print extra info: early, partial, fullhash. Valid: early, partial, fullhash, none.

summarize.description: Summarize duplicate file information at the end.

reverse.description: Reverse (invert) the sort order of matches.

omit_first.description: Omit the first file in each set of matches.

check_permissions.description: Don't consider files with different owner/group or permissions as duplicates.

match_zero_length.description: Consider zero-length files to be duplicates.

quick.description: Skip byte-for-byte verification (RISK OF DATA LOSS).

soft_abort.description: Act on matches found before user aborts (CTRL-C).

error_on_dupes.description: Exit with status 255 if any duplicate is found.

isolate.description: Isolate command-line parameters; only match files under different parameter specs.

partial_only.description: Match based on hash of first block only (EXTREME RISK). Requires -T -T.

print_summarize.description: Print matches and summarize at the end.
